summary: Prologis, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that underwriters J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and BofA Securities, Inc. exercised their overallotment option in connection with the company's recent underwritten offering of 15,000,000 common shares that closed on August 5, 2026. The underwriters purchased an additional 2,250,000 shares at the offering price, generating aggregate net proceeds of approximately $312.2 million after underwriting discounts but before expenses. The additional shares are scheduled to close on August 7, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation, as it reflects standard follow-on offering mechanics with no strategic or structural significance beyond raising capital.
